snippet.title: Dig Dug [Handheld Longplay] (1983) Gakken
snippet.description: Full playthrough of the handheld game Dig Dug. Released back in 1983 by Gekken. Based on the original arcade game by Namco. Full playthrough of the arcade game is available at https://youtu.be/emJHrI6GVTg
